title: Backend modules and frontend screen kits.
lede: Production-tested, AI-optimized. Backend logic plus prebuilt UI for React, React Native, and Vue — take the headless hooks or the ready-made screens. Your AI doesn't guess. It follows Fonderie's instructions.

items.title: Auth (Backend + Frontend)
items.text: Login, signup, password reset, and multi-factor authentication. Plus prebuilt auth screens for React, React Native, and Vue. Your AI never writes auth from scratch.

items.title: Billing (Backend + Frontend)
items.text: Stripe integration, subscriptions, usage metering. Plus pricing tables and checkout screens for React, React Native, and Vue. Pre-built. Pre-wired.

items.title: Workspaces (Backend + Frontend)
items.text: Multi-tenant teams, invites, role-based access. Plus team-switcher and member-management screens for React, React Native, and Vue. Your customers manage their own orgs.

items.title: Notifications
items.text: Email, SMS, and push notifications, plus a template admin UI. Fire-and-forget messaging. Your AI doesn't reinvent email logic every session.

items.title: Permissions and Audit
items.text: Role-based access control, wildcard permissions, admin override. Plus a workspace-scoped audit log with a prebuilt screen on every framework.
